definition: A temporary safe house or refuge node that has been abandoned but not yet discovered by hostile parties — still usable, but with an implicit countdown. By extension, any situation or relationship that offers protection but is clearly running out of time.
origin: Street cant, evolved from literal geography of the Old Harbor district's abandoned industrial waterfront
usage: Runners, fixers, refugees, ELF sympathizers; used both literally and metaphorically throughout the corridor
example: The arrangement with Tessera's rogue archivist was a cold harbor at best — sooner or later someone upstairs would notice the data bleed.
